title: Design exercise: SAA-4.1-S08
scenario: Ashgrove Microscopy Library holds 300 TB of research images averaging 20 MB each. Some images are opened daily for months and then never again; others sit untouched for years and are suddenly requested when a paper is cited, and nobody can predict which. Every image must open in milliseconds whenever it is requested. The trustees have rejected any design whose monthly bill can jump because of retrieval charges or early-removal charges.
constraints: Do not claim live AWS experience
No per-retrieval or early-removal charge may ever appear on the bill
The library has one part-time administrator, so there are no per-project tiering rules to maintain
All images stay in one Region

rubric.label: The monthly bill contains no retrieval or early-removal charge whichever images are opened in a month
Images untouched for long periods cost less to store than frequently opened ones, without anyone classifying the images

constraint_reason: Mapped as design_exercise to complete skill coverage when no dedicated live lab step exists
